newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Malaysia's Genhold buys 58 pct of Femco.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Genhold buys 58 pct of Femco.

text.p: Malaysian firm Genaire Holdings (M) Sendirian Berhad (Genhold) said on Tuesday it had acquired effective control of South African elecric motor and components firm Femco Technology Holdings Ltd.
It said it had acquired some 32.19 million shares for 84 cents a share or 27 million rand in cash with effect from July 1 1997. This amounted to 58 percent of Femco's issued share capital.
Genhold said in a statement the acquisition was in line with its investment activities and its globalisation plans in the manufacture of air conditioners and ancilliary and related products.

"The acquisition of control of Femco is in line with Genhold's policy of further developing and enhancing its existing business activities globally, particularly in regard to the investment policy and the potential economic growth in South Africa," it said.
The company said that based on Femco's annual results for the year to December 31, the acquisition would have no immediate material effect on Femco's earnings or net asset value.

"However, it is expected that the longer term benefits expected to be derived from the Femco acquisition and resultant change of control of Femco will contribute materially to the future earnings growth of Femco."
